subject: biology-1
question: On a hot, dry day a **C3 plant**'s stomata close, causing oxygen levels to rise inside the leaf. Which of the following is the direct consequence?

options.text: The Calvin cycle speeds up because more oxygen energizes the reactions.
RuBisCO fixes oxygen instead of carbon dioxide, and photorespiration consumes ATP without producing sugar.
Photosystem II splits oxygen instead of water, doubling oxygen production.
The electron transport chain runs in reverse, pumping protons out of the thylakoid.

explanation: With stomata closed, oxygen accumulates and RuBisCO fixes oxygen instead of carbon dioxide, starting photorespiration, which burns ATP and releases already-fixed carbon without making sugar. A has the consequence backwards, since oxygen does not energize the Calvin cycle. C invents an impossible reaction, because photosystem II never splits oxygen. D contradicts the one-way flow of electrons in the transport chain.
